FISA contributes to the president's daily security briefing and thwarts terror attacks on a regular basis — saving thousands of American lives. By refusing to reauthorize this crucial tool — even after President Trump put forward a well-qualified nominee to lead ODNI — Senate Democrats are playing dangerous games with U.S. national security.

As one of the only members who has actually worked with FISA prior to joining Congress, I raised the alarms about what is at stake.
